name: valcraft-foreman
description: Coordinate or take over the spec-driven delivery loop through fresh Spec, Draft, Review, Forge, Land, and Temper workers, from a new feature, PRD, or quick-task source to landing and retrospective. Spec, Draft, Forge, and Land run only under it. Own runtime readiness, intake, takeover inference, task selection, intermediate tracker state, worker lifecycle, backend returns, report validation, approval gates, recovery, and named-state transitions. Use for a new feature, PRD, or quick task, "run the delivery loop", "take over delivery", "start sprint", "work through the tasks", "deliver quick", or "run foreman". Do not use for a standalone review (valcraft-review), retrospective (valcraft-temper), or project framing (valcraft-cast).
